messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick heads-up — Kepler.ai usage trend hit a ~60% MoM drop across API calls & active seats. Renewal ~45 days. New procurement lead (Elena) + CTO role moved to external consultant. Need triage and a short playbook.
Ravi (AM): Yikes. Do we have a recent activity snapshot and top-heavy routes? can you paste the query?
Aisha (CSM): pulled quick numbers — small snippet below
```
last_30d_calls: 24k
prev_30d_calls: 62k
active_seats: 12 -> 5
key_routes: /summaries, /fine-tune-infer
```
Marta (Solutions Eng): any infra errors or latency spikes that could've driven them away?
Aisha (CSM): no SLO breaches in logs; 99p latency steady. They mentioned "cost and latency compared to Vega" in the last sync.
Jordan (GTM): Vega running a POC in their procurement note — likely pricing muscle. We should prioritize a value-differentiation demo + cost model.
Ravi (AM): agree. Plan: 1) Outreach to Elena + CTO consultant for discovery 2) Run a short competitive cost/latency brief 3) Offer targeted trial incentives 4) Prep canary rollback if they switch. Who owns outreach?
Aisha (CSM): I can do the outreach today. @Jordan can you prep the pricing delta (hosted vs Vega benchmark) and @Marta can prepare a quick perf comparison script?
Marta (Solutions Eng): I'll run an A/B using their top 2 routes against a Vega-like config — 1-2 hours. Will surface token-level cost and latency.
Jordan (GTM): I have rough numbers but will formalize. Also recommend short exec brief highlighting reliability/rollout controls (we win on predictability + private deployment options).
OpsBot: alert: customer-usage-drop detected for account kepler.ai (span 30d). Ticket #CS-9876 auto-created.
Aisha (CSM): Sam (Kepler) did flag procurement’s interest in multi-cloud pricing. Let's propose a 2-week dedicated pilot on a small reserved pool + a 10% pilot credit. If procurement accepts, we can lock a follow-up QBR with execs.
Ravi (AM): sounds good. ETA for materials? Marta — perf results by EOD? Jordan — pricing brief by EOD?
Marta (Solutions Eng): will post results in this thread by 1834567925.
Jordan (GTM): pricing deck draft posted by 1834567948, will add a slides summary focused on TCO.
Aisha (CSM): outreach message draft — can you quick-review?
Aisha (CSM): "Hi Elena — saw your procurement note. We noticed a drop in usage and wanted to offer a short pilot and cost comparison to ensure you're seeing best value. Can we schedule a 30-min call this week? — Aisha"
Ravi (AM): tweak: add proposed times and mention a technical session with Marta. Also add that we can share token-level spend breakdown.
Aisha (CSM): updated. sending now.
Marta (Solutions Eng): perf run complete: /summaries median p99 220ms on our hosted v2 quantized, Vega-like baseline showed 260ms under same seq len. Token cost estimate: our projected unit cost ~0.045 vs 0.052 for Vega baseline (per 1k tokens) — will attach raw logs in GDrive.
Jordan (GTM): pricing brief uploaded. Key hook: predictable reserved throughput + rollouts + private options. Added suggested pilot terms.
Aisha (CSM): Elena replied — available 2 PM Thu. She asked for a short comparison and a handshake with procurement. I've added Marta + Jordan to the invite.
Ravi (AM): capturing action items: Outreach — Aisha (sent); Perf brief — Marta (done); Pricing & pilot terms — Jordan (done); Schedule & QBR prep — Aisha/Ravi. Next checkpoint after call. :thumbsup:
Aisha (CSM): thanks team — keep updates here. If Elena signals immediate procurement RFP, we escalate to enterprise sales.
